entities.name: Bohemond II of Antioch
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bohemond II was Prince of Taranto from 1111 to 1128 and Prince of Antioch from 1111/1119 to 1130. He was the son of Bohemond I, who in 1108 was forced to submit to the authority of the Byzantine Empire in the Treaty of Devol. Three years later, the infant Bohemond inherited the Principality of Taranto under the guardianship of his mother, Constance of France. Until 1119, the Principality of Antioch was administered successively by two of Bohemond's cousins, Tancred of Galilee and Roger of Salerno.
